verdict.rationale: Semgrep CLI clearly supports headless scanning with machine-readable output: `semgrep scan --json` and SARIF export are documented and independently probe-verified to run offline/keylessly and produce parseable JSON findings (semgrep-docs-3, semgrep-docs-20, semgrep-probe-5, semgrep-probe-7). This gives an agent everything needed to run scans and parse results, but there's no first-party evidence of a documented 'file issues automatically' pipeline in the CLI itself — issue filing is only implied via PR/MR comments or the AppSec Platform API (semgrep-docs-10, semgrep-docs-17), and a community report notes LLM agents hallucinating semgrep functions (semgrep-comm-13). missing for 10: end-to-end documented example of an agent auto-filing tickets/issues from CLI JSON output, and independent confirmation of reliability of that automated triage-to-issue step.
